name: Thermal Management of Compact Power Systems
summary: Keeping motors, drives, batteries and electronics in dense machines and wearables within temperature limits using conduction, liquid, phase-change and thermoelectric cooling.

topics.name: Heat sources and thermal budgets in compact machines (motors, drives, batteries, electronics)
Heat spreading, heat sinks and fin optimisation
Thermal interface materials and contact resistance
Liquid cooling: cold plates, pumps, radiators and loop design
Heat pipes, vapour chambers and loop heat pipes
Phase-change materials for transient thermal buffering
Motor and actuator thermal management (winding temperature, potting, housings)
Human-contact and wearable thermal limits (skin temperature, garment cooling)
Thermal simulation and testing (conjugate heat transfer CFD, IR thermography)
